disclaimer: Fictional data created for the MarketSignal demo.
hypothesis: Gen Z customers will pay a premium for personalized products
anchor_rules: Sentence anchors appear verbatim exactly once per workspace after collapsing whitespace runs to one space; row anchors match exactly one row (sheet null for CSV).

contradictions.topic: Stated willingness to pay a 15% premium (38%) vs revealed uptake of the 15% premium tier in the pilot (9%).
Early week-six pilot read of 27% repeat vs final 90-day repeat of 18% (below 24% control).
